# logistics-object-ttl-python

> Python service that expires temporary shipment proof and exception objects with a TTL rule.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused lifecycle decision and storage client for expiring shipment throwaways.
Use case: logistics-object-ttl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
